claude_proposed_widenings.name: subclass_selection
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The unit's sole mechanic is a permanent character-progression gate: at level 3, the player chooses a subclass. The existing ClassFeatureMechanics has only one family, 'activation', which requires activationCost + resource (use_count) + resetCadence + effect (GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect). 'Gain a subclass of your choice' fits none of these — it is neither an activated effect nor a heal/action-grant. A new family is needed to represent 'subclass selection at a given level.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a Cleric subclass of your choice. The Life Domain subclass is detailed after this class's description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Cleric levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Cleric level or lower.
